title: Sowing the Wind, Reaping the Whirlwind: The Impact of Editing Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the models with sensitive and unethical questions from the proposed NICHEHAZARDQA dataset and using GPT-4 as an automatic evaluator to classify whether the generated responses contain hate speech or discriminatory content before and after model editing.

Evaluating model responses to explicitly toxic questions from the DengerousQA dataset, which categorizes prompts using adjectives such as 'racist', 'sexist', and 'stereotypical', and measuring the shift from ethical to unethical response generation post-editing using GPT-4.
